name: HF Group Plc
source: CRON 2026-10-14: HFCB Group Plc, formerly HF Group, unaudited results for the six months ended 30 June 2026. Unit KES. Net interest income KES 2,644.26m, total operating income KES 3.80bn, operating expenses KES 2.58bn, profit before tax KES 1.23bn, profit after tax KES 988.33m. Income tax KES 241.67m is profit before tax less profit after tax. EPS and EBIT are left empty because the published EPS differs between sources against a share count this file does not carry, and the half year printed no pre exceptional profit line.
source_note: KShs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. Group figures. | Operating Profit (EBIT) from the audited FY2025 statement Group columns, whose profit before tax ties to the stored Profit Before Tax by adding the printed exceptional items. Group earnings per share printed as 0.90 (FY2024) and 0.75 (FY2025) was NOT stored: it does not reconcile with the stored share count, so the cell stays empty rather than carrying a figure that fails a sanity check. | CRON 20261004_1032: EPS row added, Basic and diluted 0.75 (FY2025) and 0.90 (FY2024), from the issuer's FY2025 annual report as summarised by africanfinancials (HF Group Limited HFCK.ke 2025 Annual Report and 2025 Abridged Report, both reading the issuer's own statement). EPS uses weighted-average shares, so it does not equal Profit for the Year over shares in issue; the file's sharesOutstanding of 1.98bn is the post-rights count.
